summary: Tested LensTranslate backend (POST /api/translate) and Expo/RN web frontend. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests passed — root endpoint returns {'message':'LensTranslate API'}; /api/translate correctly returns detected_source + regions with 0-100% boxes for auto→tr, auto→ja (Japanese chars), auto→ru (Cyrillic chars), manual source_lang=en, and returns regions: [] for an image with no readable text. Frontend: Home renders (LensTranslate title, Kaynak/Hedef chips defaulting to 'Otomatik algıla' & 'Türkçe', dropzone hero, 'Galeriden seç'/'Fotoğraf çek' buttons, bottom tabs Çeviri/Geçmiş/Ayarlar); language bottom sheet works — source sheet exposes 'Otomatik algıla', target sheet correctly does NOT; swap button swaps source/target once source is a concrete language; History empty state shows 'Henüz çeviri yok'; Settings default source picker exposes 'Otomatik algıla'; interface language change to English updates all UI labels (tabs, chips, buttons) reactively. BUG FOUND: theme segmented control (Sistem/Açık/Koyu) updates the active button visually but does NOT switch the app palette on the Expo web preview — root surface stays rgb(250,250,250) after selecting Koyu (verified via getComputedStyle and screenshots).

ui_bugs.issue: Selecting 'Koyu' (Dark) or 'Açık' (Light) updates the active pill but the underlying colors (surface, cards, text) do NOT change on the Expo web preview. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts uses Appearance.setColorScheme(...) + useColorScheme() to drive the palette; on React Native Web useColorScheme only tracks the OS `prefers-color-scheme` media query and is not updated by Appearance.setColorScheme, so useTheme() never re-derives to dark. Suggested fix: store the effective ColorScheme in a Context (or the existing StoreProvider) and have useTheme() read that context (falling back to useColorScheme() only when themeMode === 'system').

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning at load: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Likely from a dependency (bottom-sheet / reanimated) or app code passing pointerEvents as a prop.

action_items: Fix light/dark theme toggle on web: make useTheme() read the app-controlled themeMode from StoreProvider (not just useColorScheme). When themeMode === 'light' or 'dark', force the corresponding palette regardless of Appearance/OS. Keep useColorScheme() only as input when themeMode === 'system'.
(Minor) Audit code for `pointerEvents` prop and move it into style.pointerEvents to silence the RN 0.7x deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider lifespan handler (non-blocking).
frontend/src/theme.ts: theme is derived only from useColorScheme(); this is why the in-app dark/light toggle has no visible effect on web (see bug above).

rca_of_issue: Theme toggle no-op on web — Reproduction: open /(tabs)/settings, note bg color rgb(250,250,250); tap 'Koyu' segment (data-testid=theme-dark); the active pill turns green but bg stays rgb(250,250,250). RCA: /app/frontend/src/store.tsx setThemeMode() calls applyTheme() → setColorScheme() in theme.ts → Appearance.setColorScheme(). On RN Web, Appearance.setColorScheme is a no-op with respect to useColorScheme(), which reads window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme)') only. Since useTheme() derives colors solely from useColorScheme(), palette never switches. Mitigation: expose themeMode (already persisted in store) to useTheme via context and pick palette explicitly for 'light'/'dark', use useColorScheme only for 'system'.
